review.images: Used the exact current Emaar Parkside Hills page. Kept six distinct developer views, omitting the narrower pool crop repeated by the hero. The entrance render is the project card. Used the kitchen and bedroom for the residence details.
review.location: Checked the official Parkside Hills point and district map. Brochure physical page 5 marks the specific site near the mall and park. The original gives 15 minutes to Downtown and Dubai Marina, 20 minutes in a single combined entry for both airports and 25 minutes to District 2020.
review.floorPlans: Fresh official bytes matched the cached 20-page original. Reviewed the cover and all 19 unedited apartment sheets, including 11 with multiple printed area tables. Physical table positions identify the correct unit group. Cross-checked all area figures against an independent extraction. Differences of 0.01 sq ft are retained as published.

unavailable: Current building entrance, signed unit area and live route times require confirmation.
